text:
Taylor: Random thought  sunset fondue + tiny plant swap + improv charades on the rooftop next Thursday? thinking 6:45 meet, fondue 7-8, swap table + charades after. :cheese_wedge: :evergreen_tree: :performing_arts:
Samir: omg yes. fondue mood. whos on fondue duty?
Priyanka: i can bring a portable burner and pot. any nut allergies? fondue + nuts = risky.
Ben: allergic to tree nuts  sesame's fine. please label.
Lei: i'm into the plant swap! i have two little succulents to trade. also can bring a watering can.
Taylor: noted on tree nuts. we'll do strictly labeled toppings and a dedicated nut-free bowl. good call.
Samir: budget? $10-15 suggested to cover cheese + dippers?
Priyanka: $12 sounds fair. i'll grab cheese + bread; can others bring dippers (veggies, fruit, cured meats)?
Ben: i can bring charcuterie for non-veg options. also happy to handle cleanup.
Lei: i'll bring fruit + vegan dippers (tofu cubes, roasted cauliflower).
Taylor: love it. MurmurBot can you spin up an RSVP + perform poll for charades?
MurmurBot: Poll created: "Fondue rooftop RSVP & charades" Options: Yes - perform, Yes - watch, Maybe, No. Link: https://murmur.example/p/fgw2
Priyanka: I'll perform a 2-minute improv skit if people want.
Samir: spectator here, but i'll DJ a short playlist for the rooftop walk.
Ben: how many people can the rooftop safely hold after hours? don't want to break rules.
Taylor: building rules allow up to 20 for private events after 7 as long as we keep music low and don't block the fire exit. we'll cap at 16 to be safe.
Lei: can someone add this to the calendar and note plant-swap rules (label pots, soil-free trades allowed)?
Taylor: adding now. link: https://calendar.example/event/fondue-plant-swap
Priyanka: also request: can someone bring small compostable plates/napkins?
Samir: i'll bring compostable napkins + a small bin for scraps.
Ben: rides? i'll drive 3 people, leaving 6:15 from Union St.
Lei: tiny heads-up: i'm bringing a potted plant with a saucer  DM me if you'd prefer potless trades.
Taylor: perfect. last Q: dessert? maybe mini s'mores skewers after charades? low-key.
Priyanka: yes pls. i can bring chocolate squares and marshmallows (GF options too).
MurmurBot: Calendar event created and RSVP poll posted. Reminder set 24 hrs before.
Taylor: great team. see you Thursday  bring plant tags, comfy shoes, and charade energy. :sparkles:
